Between what times could Anthony have gone to the park?

(A) 2pm to 5pm
(B) 5pm to 8pm
(C) 6am to 2pm
(D) 8pm to 9pm

- From 2pm to 5pm, Anthony was seen by Richard, so he cannot have gone to the park during this time.
